scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' INT; bun run dev:gateway & bun run dev:server & bun run dev:web & wait
scripts.build: cd packages/shared && bun run build && cd ../web && bun run build && cd ../server && bun run build
scripts.test:bun: cd packages/server && bunx --bun vitest run --config vitest.bun.config.ts
scripts.lint: bun run lint:format && bun run lint:palette && bun run lint:eslint && bun run lint:types
scripts.lint:types: tsc -b packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sidepanel-host/tsconfig.json
